verdicts.reason: A is broken. The white frame has come loose from the halftone artwork and floats as an empty box in the middle of the banner. The three info lines are spread far apart with big gaps between them, the divider bars bump into the text ('GALLERY|', 'NOVAK.AU|'), and a stray rule sits at the top-left corner. B keeps the frame layered on the artwork and groups the gallery, URL and date lines into one tidy block next to a headline that clearly leads. Its flaws: the two divider rules are left floating at the top-left instead of framing the headline, there are stray tick marks on the left and far right, and there is dead space at the left and right ends.
